data.name: Masarrah
data.gender_notes: Masarrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root s-r-r, meaning 'to convey, to speak'. Masarrah is the one who speaks, the communicator, the one who conveys messages and ideas. It is a beautiful name for a girl in Islamic tradition. The name Masarrah carries the meaning “A speaker, one who conveys” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masarrah usually hope their child will grow to embody a speaker, one who conveys and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies a person who conveys the message of Allah SWT to others, making her a beacon of knowledge and guidance.
data.etymology: Masarrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A speaker, one who conveys.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Masarrah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
